The fish displays an elongated fusiform body with visible bony scutes along the dorsal ridge and lateral line. The head is pointed with a visible eye and barbels hanging from the snout area. The tail appears heterocercal. In the foreground, there are blurry, dark shapes that resemble other fish or shadows, possibly juvenile sturgeons or catfish, but they are out of focus.
